mapper.select: select (select count(1) from wms_warehouse) as warehouseCount, (select count(1) from wms_location) as locationCount, (select count(1) from wms_item) as itemCount, (select count(1) from wms_item_sku) as skuCount, coalesce((select sum(quantity) from wms_inventory), 0) as totalStockQuantity, coalesce(( select sum(inv.quantity * coalesce(sku.selling_price, 0)) from wms_inventory inv inner join wms_item_sku sku on inv.sku_id = sku.id ), 0) as stockSellingValue, coalesce(( select sum(inv.quantity * coalesce(sku.cost_price, 0)) from wms_inventory inv inner join wms_item_sku sku on inv.sku_id = sku.id ), 0) as stockCostValue, coalesce(( select sum(coalesce(orders.total_amount, detail_totals.detail_amount, 0)) from wms_shipment_order orders left join ( select detail.order_id, sum(coalesce(detail.amount, detail.quantity * coalesce(sku.selling_price, 0))) as detail_amount from wms_shipment_order_detail detail left join wms_item_sku sku on detail.sku_id = sku.id group by detail.order_id ) detail_totals on detail_totals.order_id = orders.id where orders.order_status = 1 and orders.biz_date = curdate() ), 0) as todayTurnover, coalesce(( select sum(coalesce(orders.total_amount, detail_totals.detail_amount, 0)) from wms_receipt_order orders left join ( select detail.order_id, sum(coalesce(detail.amount, detail.quantity * coalesce(sku.cost_price, 0))) as detail_amount from wms_receipt_order_detail detail left join wms_item_sku sku on detail.sku_id = sku.id group by detail.order_id ) detail_totals on detail_totals.order_id = orders.id where orders.order_status = 1 and orders.biz_date = curdate() ), 0) as todayReceiptAmount, coalesce(( select sum(coalesce(orders.total_quantity, detail_totals.detail_quantity, 0)) from wms_shipment_order orders left join ( select order_id, sum(quantity) as detail_quantity from wms_shipment_order_detail group by order_id ) detail_totals on detail_totals.order_id = orders.id where orders.order_status = 1 and orders.biz_date = curdate() ), 0) as todayShipmentQuantity, coalesce(( select sum(coalesce(orders.total_quantity, detail_totals.detail_quantity, 0)) from wms_receipt_order orders left join ( select order_id, sum(quantity) as detail_quantity from wms_receipt_order_detail group by order_id ) detail_totals on detail_totals.order_id = orders.id where orders.order_status = 1 and orders.biz_date = curdate() ), 0) as todayReceiptQuantity, (select count(1) from wms_shipment_order where order_status = 1 and biz_date = curdate()) as todayShipmentOrders, (select count(1) from wms_receipt_order where order_status = 1 and biz_date = curdate()) as todayReceiptOrders, (select count(1) from wms_shipment_order where order_status = 0) as pendingShipmentOrders, (select count(1) from wms_receipt_order where order_status = 0) as pendingReceiptOrders, coalesce(( select count(1) from ( select sku_id, sum(quantity) as quantity from wms_inventory group by sku_id having quantity > 0 and quantity <= 5 ) low_stock ), 0) as lowStockSkuCount, coalesce(( select count(1) from ( select sku_id, sum(quantity) as quantity from wms_inventory group by sku_id having quantity = 0 ) empty_stock ), 0) as emptyStockSkuCount

select day, sum(receiptOrders) as receiptOrders, sum(shipmentOrders) as shipmentOrders, sum(receiptQuantity) as receiptQuantity, sum(shipmentQuantity) as shipmentQuantity, sum(receiptAmount) as receiptAmount, sum(turnover) as turnover from ( select orders.biz_date as day, count(1) as receiptOrders, 0 as shipmentOrders, coalesce(sum(coalesce(orders.total_quantity, detail_totals.detail_quantity, 0)), 0) as receiptQuantity, 0 as shipmentQuantity, coalesce(sum(coalesce(orders.total_amount, detail_totals.detail_amount, 0)), 0) as receiptAmount, 0 as turnover from wms_receipt_order orders left join ( select detail.order_id, sum(detail.quantity) as detail_quantity, sum(coalesce(detail.amount, detail.quantity * coalesce(sku.cost_price, 0))) as detail_amount from wms_receipt_order_detail detail left join wms_item_sku sku on detail.sku_id = sku.id group by detail.order_id ) detail_totals on detail_totals.order_id = orders.id where orders.order_status = 1 and orders.biz_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval (#{days} - 1) day) group by orders.biz_date union all select orders.biz_date as day, 0 as receiptOrders, count(1) as shipmentOrders, 0 as receiptQuantity, coalesce(sum(coalesce(orders.total_quantity, detail_totals.detail_quantity, 0)), 0) as shipmentQuantity, 0 as receiptAmount, coalesce(sum(coalesce(orders.total_amount, detail_totals.detail_amount, 0)), 0) as turnover from wms_shipment_order orders left join ( select detail.order_id, sum(detail.quantity) as detail_quantity, sum(coalesce(detail.amount, detail.quantity * coalesce(sku.selling_price, 0))) as detail_amount from wms_shipment_order_detail detail left join wms_item_sku sku on detail.sku_id = sku.id group by detail.order_id ) detail_totals on detail_totals.order_id = orders.id where orders.order_status = 1 and orders.biz_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval (#{days} - 1) day) group by orders.biz_date ) daily group by day order by day

select wh.id as warehouseId, wh.warehouse_name as warehouseName, coalesce(sum(inv.quantity), 0) as quantity, coalesce(sum(inv.quantity * coalesce(sku.selling_price, 0)), 0) as sellingValue, coalesce(sum(inv.quantity * coalesce(sku.cost_price, 0)), 0) as costValue from wms_warehouse wh left join wms_inventory inv on inv.warehouse_id = wh.id left join wms_item_sku sku on inv.sku_id = sku.id group by wh.id, wh.warehouse_name order by quantity desc

select sku.id as skuId, item.item_name as itemName, sku.sku_name as skuName, coalesce(sum(detail.quantity), 0) as quantity, coalesce(sum(coalesce(detail.amount, detail.quantity * coalesce(sku.selling_price, 0))), 0) as amount from wms_shipment_order_detail detail inner join wms_shipment_order orders on detail.order_id = orders.id inner join wms_item_sku sku on detail.sku_id = sku.id inner join wms_item item on sku.item_id = item.id where orders.order_status = 1 and orders.biz_date >= date_sub(curdate(), interval (#{days} - 1) day) group by sku.id, item.item_name, sku.sku_name order by quantity desc limit #{limit}

select sku.id as skuId, item.item_name as itemName, sku.sku_name as skuName, coalesce(sum(inv.quantity), 0) as quantity, coalesce(max(loc.location_code), '-') as locationCode from wms_inventory inv inner join wms_item_sku sku on inv.sku_id = sku.id inner join wms_item item on sku.item_id = item.id left join wms_location loc on sku.item_location_id = loc.id group by sku.id, item.item_name, sku.sku_name having quantity > 0 and quantity <= 5 order by quantity asc, item.item_name asc limit #{limit}
